title: Internship Selection Prediction Dataset
author: AI Explorer (aiexplorer77)
transformations: Aptitude, communication and interview scores multiplied by 10 to align the source 1–10 scale with the app 0–100 fields.
Removed student_id and all other unused columns. No new labels or feature values were generated.
limitations: Educational synthetic data, not observed hiring outcomes.
No language names or internship duration measurements exist in this source.
Some source selection factors are unavailable in this form, so performance can be limited.
Predictions outside the source ranges are unsupported.
Metrics describe this dataset only and are not hiring accuracy.
